name: Duda
description_en:
Duda is a hosted website platform aimed at businesses that build and manage sites for other businesses. Its account plans combine a site builder, client access, collaboration and AI tools with a limited number of included published projects; additional live sites and services add to the bill.

The important evaluation is the agency workflow: collect client content, build and review a site, restrict client permissions, publish it and maintain the account portfolio. Duda also markets Vibe for app generation, but its documented website export tool explicitly excludes Vibe projects and does not reproduce the hosted platform’s dynamic services.
description_zh:
Duda 是面向为其他企业建设和管理网站的公司的托管平台。账户方案结合建站、客户访问、协作和 AI 工具，并包含一定数量的已发布项目；额外上线站点及服务会增加费用。

评估重点是代理机构流程：收集客户内容、建站与审阅、限制客户权限、发布并维护站点组合。Duda 另有用于生成应用的 Vibe，但网站导出文档明确排除 Vibe 项目，也不会复制托管平台的动态服务。

core_features.explanation_en: Basic and Team include one published project; Agency and White Label include four. More live sites have separate subscription charges.
core_features.explanation_zh: Basic 和 Team 包含一个已发布项目，Agency 与 White Label 包含四个，更多上线站点另行订阅。

core_features.explanation_en: Client accounts access assigned sites; team members can access portfolio/platform features subject to their permissions. White-label branding is a higher-tier capability.
core_features.explanation_zh: 客户账户访问指定站点，团队成员按权限使用站点组合和平台功能；白标品牌能力属于较高方案。

core_features.name_zh: 受限制的静态网站导出
core_features.explanation_en: Agency and higher can export a published website up to 1 GB; forms, dynamic pages, memberships and other hosted behavior are excluded or stop working.
core_features.explanation_zh: Agency 及以上可导出不超过 1 GB 的已发布网站；表单、动态页面、会员等托管行为不包含或停止工作。

pricing.summary_en: Paid account plans from $25/month monthly or $19/month equivalent billed annually upfront. Included live projects, extra sites, commerce/bookings and AI add-ons affect total cost; 14-day trial is not ongoing free hosting.
pricing.summary_zh: 付费账户月付起价 $25/月，年付一次预收月均起价 $19。上线名额、额外站点、电商/预约及 AI 附加项影响总费用；14 天试用不等于持续免费托管。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Start with one representative client delivery
sections.title_zh: 先验证一个代表性客户交付
sections.en: Use the 14-day no-card trial to build a client site and test content collection, design review and the client’s editing permissions. Client-management documentation places commenting from Agency, limits commenting to up to 100 client accounts on most plans, and makes billing dependent on a Stripe account in a supported country; Stripe processing fees can apply. The current pricing FAQ says the trial exposes White Label features; do not assume a cheaper paid plan retains every trial feature. Duda distinguishes client users, limited to assigned sites, from staff/team users with broader platform access. For a one-off personal site, assess whether agency collaboration adds value; for repeated client delivery, compare the included live-site allowance and staff seats against the real portfolio.
sections.zh: 可用 14 天免银行卡试用构建一个客户网站，验证内容收集、设计审阅及客户编辑权限。客户管理文档将评论能力置于 Agency 起，多数方案最多支持 100 个参与评论的客户账户；客户账单需要受支持国家的 Stripe 账户，并可能收取 Stripe 处理费。当前定价 FAQ 说试用提供 White Label 功能，因此不能假定较低付费方案保留试用期全部能力。Duda 将仅能访问指定站点的客户用户与拥有更广平台访问权限的员工/团队用户区分。个人单站应评估机构协作能力是否有用；重复交付客户网站则应根据真实站点组合核算上线名额和团队席位。

sections.title_en: Budget the account, live sites and add-ons
sections.title_zh: 核算账户、上线站点和附加项
sections.en: Prices are explicitly USD per account. Basic/Team/Agency/White Label display $25/$39/$69/$199 per month on monthly billing, or $19/$29/$52/$149 per month equivalent billed annually upfront. The first two include one published project and the latter two four. Extra Website Builder sites are $19/month or $171/year on Basic, and $17/month or $168/year on Team, Agency and White Label. Vibe projects have a distinct additional-project row, so obtain that quote for an app portfolio. The flattened comparison includes unlabeled discounted numbers as well as regular rates; no temporary discount is assumed here. Taxes and eCommerce/Bookings purchases can be additional.
sections.zh: 价格明确为每账户美元。Basic/Team/Agency/White Label 月付显示每月 $25/$39/$69/$199；年付一次预收的月均为 $19/$29/$52/$149。前两者含一个已发布项目，后两者含四个。额外 Website Builder 站点在 Basic 为 $19/月或 $171/年，其他三个方案为 $17/月或 $168/年。Vibe 有独立的额外项目价格行，应用组合应单独取得报价。扁平化比较表同时出现无明确标签的折扣数字和常规价，此处不假定临时折扣有效。税费、电商及预约购买可能另计。

sections.en: Paid accounts list 150 monthly AI credits, with one-time top-ups priced inside Billing. These credits apply to advanced features such as Vibe, custom-widget generation and Copilot actions. AI Visibility is a separate add-on starting at $19/month, with domain, prompt, engine and response allowances; it is not unlimited AI-search placement. Duda states that hosted sites use AWS/CloudFront, include unlimited storage/bandwidth and have a 99.5% uptime target. These are vendor service claims, not measured results or a guarantee of search rankings. Audit forms, checkout, bookings and domain behavior on the intended plan before handing over a live client site.
sections.zh: 付费账户列出每月 150 个 AI 额度，一次性加购价格在 Billing 内查看，适用于 Vibe、自定义组件生成和 Copilot 操作等高级功能。AI Visibility 是起价 $19/月的独立附加项，受域名、提示、引擎和响应额度限制，不是无限 AI 搜索曝光。Duda 表示其托管站点使用 AWS/CloudFront，含不限存储/带宽及 99.5% 可用性目标。这是厂商服务描述，不是本次测量结果，也不保证搜索排名。交付真实客户网站前，应在目标方案验证表单、结账、预约和域名行为。

sections.title_en: Export is a partial migration, not the hosted service
sections.title_zh: 导出是部分迁移，需重建托管行为
sections.en: Site Export is available on Agency and higher for account owners or staff. Publish first, then open More → Settings → Site Export to download the live version, up to 1 GB. The ZIP contains HTML/CSS/JavaScript and media in device-specific folders. The store is absent (products can separately export to CSV), the blog is RSS rather than HTML, and dynamic pages, membership/app data and the 404 page are excluded. Contact forms and personalization stop working. Password-protection behavior is not exported even though its pages are, so protect sensitive pages before hosting elsewhere. The exported site cannot be edited with Duda’s builder, reimported into another account or supported by Duda on the new host. Vibe projects cannot use this export.
sections.zh: Site Export 供 Agency 及以上方案的账户所有者或员工使用。先发布，再进入 More → Settings → Site Export 下载不超过 1 GB 的线上版本。ZIP 按设备生成 HTML/CSS/JavaScript 和媒体文件夹。商店不包含在内，商品可另导出 CSV；博客以 RSS 而非 HTML 提供，动态页面、会员/应用数据及 404 页面被排除。联系表单和个性化停止工作。密码保护行为不会导出，但页面本身会，因此在其他主机部署前必须另行保护敏感页面。导出站点不能继续用 Duda 建站器编辑、不能重新导入另一账户，Duda 也不支持新主机上的运行。Vibe 项目不能使用此导出。

sections.en: For a few incoming sites, Duda recommends rebuilding with Import Content, which extracts text and images into the Media Panel; larger migrations may involve experts or sales. This does not promise a full-fidelity application import. Export permission also does not establish an open-source license: the export FAQ prohibits unminifying the JS/CSS or copying template designs for resale. A team requiring a self-managed dynamic application should first scope replacements for platform forms, stores, membership and editing. No migration, API call, account workflow or reliability test was performed in this review.
sections.zh: 迁入少量站点时，Duda 建议用 Import Content 将文本和图片提取到媒体面板后重建；更大迁移可能需要专家或销售服务。这不承诺完整保真导入应用。允许导出也不等于开源许可：FAQ 禁止反格式化压缩的 JS/CSS，或复制模板设计出售。需要自管动态应用的团队应先明确如何替换平台表单、商店、会员和编辑能力。本次未执行迁移、API 调用、账户流程或可靠性测试。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: API/SSO entitlement, custom contract terms and exact Vibe portfolio costs need confirmation for the intended plan; no API or editor test was run.
research_gaps.zh: 目标方案的 API/SSO 权利、自定义合同及 Vibe 组合具体费用需确认；未实测 API 或编辑器。

research_gaps.en: Exported widgets and external services need a real migration test; exported static files do not prove operational equivalence.
research_gaps.zh: 导出组件和外部服务需要实际迁移测试；静态文件不证明运行行为等价。
